name: Archer push-up
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands set very wide.
Shift your weight to one hand and bend that elbow as you lower your chest toward it.
Keep the other arm long and straight out to the side.
Push back to the middle, then lower to the other side.
cue: Lower to one hand, other arm stays straight
mistakes: Twisting the hips toward the working arm.
